description: Ask the company a free-text question (requirements, deposit, insurance, documents, opening hours, pickup instructions…). Bota answers in the customer's language with the company's approved information. Read-only: it never starts, changes or completes a booking; to quote or book use search_availability and the booking tools.

language.description: Language of the conversation, BCP-47 (es, en, pt-BR, fr, de, it…). Defaults to 'en'. Bota also answers in the language the customer writes.

name: ask_company
title: Ask the rental company
